title: Marlow Court
text: Quiet townhouse hotel on a side street, thick walls, small rooms, breakfast included, ten minutes to the old town.

title: Atrium Nine
text: Big glass-fronted business hotel with a gym, late checkout and an airport shuttle. Rooms face a busy road.

title: Perren Square
text: Grand old hotel right on the main square, high ceilings, slow lifts, and trams passing under the windows.

title: Tinderbox Rooms
text: Cheap private rooms above a hostel bar, shared kitchen, very central, loud until well past midnight.

title: Willowbank House
text: Family-run guesthouse in a garden suburb, very quiet, good breakfast, a twenty minute tram ride from the centre.

title: Corvo Lofts
text: Serviced apartments with a full kitchen and a washing machine, no reception, self check-in by keypad.

title: Verge Central
text: Modern budget rooms, tiny but spotless, right above a metro station, no breakfast and no bar.

title: Lantern Quay
text: Waterfront hotel with a rooftop pool and a restaurant that most guests complain is overpriced.

title: The Brambling
text: Small design hotel, twelve rooms, honesty bar, no lift, and staff who book restaurants for you.

title: Station Halt Inn
text: Functional rooms directly beside the railway station, thin walls, cheap, and very easy to reach at night.

title: Orchard Gate
text: Quiet mid-range hotel with a courtyard garden, free breakfast buffet, parking, and a slow walk into town.

title: Fenrow Studios
text: Bare studio flats with a kitchenette, cheap for a week, thin mattresses and an unreliable lift.

title: Cassin Park
text: Large park-side hotel with a spa, quiet rooms at the back, and a breakfast that runs until eleven.

title: Morrow Arcade
text: Rooms above a covered shopping arcade in the centre, convenient, bright, and noisy from early morning.

title: Selby Crown
text: Comfortable four star with a pool, gym and a good bar, on a ring road with no restaurants nearby.

title: Inkwell House
text: Literary-themed boutique rooms, a library on the ground floor, quiet, and a five minute walk to the museums.

title: Grange Loop
text: Airport hotel with soundproofed rooms and a free shuttle, useful for an early flight, useless for a city break.

title: Porthaven Rooms
text: Bright rooms over a harbour cafe, breakfast on the terrace, gulls from five in the morning onwards.

title: Glasshouse Eleven
text: Expensive design hotel with a rooftop bar, a pool, and a reputation for a very good breakfast.

title: The Quiet Mile
text: Adults-only guesthouse on a pedestrian street, no bar, no television, and genuinely silent at night.
